estimate_basis.reason: Up to six fresh C22 visits; up to 100 s per measured arm plus 10–15 s load/restore per visit and overhead.

model: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-MTP Q8_0, unchanged C22 ce6fcbbde, four split 131072-token slots, f16 KV and MTP D2
decision_rule: Compare ON28 decode, OFF56 delivered TTFT, both-finish wall and mixed iteration p99 under 0/0 and 256/900. Lower is better. Compare two reversed pairs, consider 1.30 TTFT ratio and 900 ms p99, and stop once measured effects exceed same-arm repeat range or the TTFT futility tradeoff is reproduced. Maximum three matched pairs. Stop on runtime, identity, cache or residency failure.

futility.rule: After two reversed pairs, stop if both exceed the peer TTFT ratio ceiling and each TTFT penalty exceeds repeat variation.
